common.intended_use_statement: ONCOLINK is a research and education prototype. It is not a medical device, does not diagnose cancer, and must not be used for clinical decisions. Only a biopsy can confirm oral cancer. All data comes from public datasets and consenting volunteers.

instructions.left_cheek: Pull your left cheek gently away from your teeth using a clean spoon or finger. Point the camera at the inner lining.
instructions.right_cheek: Pull your right cheek gently away from your teeth using a clean spoon or finger. Point the camera at the inner lining.
instructions.tongue_top: Stick your tongue out flat towards your chin. Keep the top surface well lit and centered.
instructions.tongue_sides: Stick out your tongue and turn it to one side. Keep it in the frame.
instructions.floor_of_mouth: Touch the tip of your tongue to the roof of your mouth. Point the camera underneath the tongue.
instructions.hard_palate: Tilt your head back and open wide. Point the camera up towards the roof of your mouth.
instructions.lips_and_gums: Pull your lips back to expose your front teeth and gums. Keep the camera steady.

capture.view_type_help: Protocol requires at least one lesion close-up and two context views.
capture.camera_unavailable: Camera feed is unavailable. You can choose a photo file directly.

reasons.too_blurry: Photo is too blurry. Hold the phone steady and tap to focus before retaking.
reasons.too_dark: Photo is too dark. Turn on a light or move near a window, then retake.
reasons.too_bright: Photo is too bright. Adjust lighting or angle to reduce glare, then retake.
reasons.too_small: Photo resolution is too low. Move closer to the lesion, then retake.
reasons.low_detail: Photo lacks clear texture and detail. Clean camera lens and retake.

questionnaire.heavy_bleeding_label: Are you experiencing heavy bleeding from the mouth?
questionnaire.difficulty_breathing_label: Are you having difficulty breathing or swallowing air?
questionnaire.rapid_swelling_label: Have you noticed rapid swelling in your mouth, face, or neck in the last few days?
questionnaire.lesion_duration_label: How many weeks has the lesion or mouth ulcer been present?
questionnaire.lesion_pain_label: Is the lesion painful or tender?
questionnaire.lesion_non_healing_label: Has the lesion been present for more than two weeks without healing?
questionnaire.lesion_bleeding_label: Does the lesion bleed easily when touched or brushed?
questionnaire.lesion_patch_label: Is there a persistent white or red patch in the mouth?
questionnaire.lesion_lump_label: Do you feel a lump, thickening, or rough spot in the mouth?
questionnaire.difficulty_swallowing_label: Do you have difficulty or pain when swallowing food or liquids?
questionnaire.difficulty_opening_label: Do you have difficulty opening your mouth fully?
questionnaire.difficulty_speaking_label: Do you have difficulty speaking or moving your tongue?
questionnaire.weight_loss_label: Have you experienced unexplained weight loss recently?
questionnaire.family_cancer_label: Is there a family history of oral or other cancers?
